lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical lines, roughly parallel and evenly spaced across the central torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments at the far anterior (near shoulder) and posterior (near rump) positions are truncated and do not reach the dorsal or ventral edges of the torso pattern.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 3-4 small white spots is visible on the upper posterior flank/haunch.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes, white spots on the lower cheeks, and white transverse bands on the lower limbs above the hooves.
